title: Finding
description: A validated research finding appended to workspace/research-vault/knowledge/findings.jsonl by the research-openclaw agent. Findings are promoted claims grounded in at least one source. Hermes and subconscious agents read findings to inform decisions and drift walks.

finding_id.description: Stable UUIDv4 for this finding. Never reuse across updates; create a new finding with supersedes_id.

run_id.description: Run receipt ID of the research run that produced this finding.

supersedes_id.description: Optional. finding_id of a prior finding this one replaces.

topic.description: Domain topic or dossier key this finding belongs to (e.g. 'otel-tracing', 'btc-mining-efficiency').

summary.description: Concise summary of the finding in plain language. Must be standalone-readable without source context.

detail.description: Optional extended detail, analysis, or raw extracted content supporting the summary.

confidence.description: Confidence in the finding. 'speculative' findings are flagged and not promoted to build intents without human review.

signal_value.description: Estimated signal value for subconscious pattern-noticing. 'noise' findings are stored but excluded from signal scoring.

evidence.description: Source references grounding this finding. At least one required.

source_id.description: UUID of a source record in sources.jsonl.

excerpt.description: Optional verbatim excerpt from the source supporting this finding.

oldest_source_date.description: Publication date of the oldest source in evidence[].

within_threshold.description: Whether all sources are within the configured freshness_threshold_h.

related_findings.description: finding_ids of related or corroborating findings.

dossier_ref.description: Optional path to an associated dossier file in workspace/research-vault/dossiers/.

examples.title: W3C traceparent propagation is not forwarded through broker job submit payloads
examples.summary: Current broker job submission payloads do not carry W3C traceparent headers, breaking distributed trace continuity between Hermes supervisor spans and OpenClaw worker execution spans.

evidence.relevance: W3C trace context spec confirms traceparent must be propagated across all async boundaries.
evidence.excerpt: Vendors MUST propagate trace context headers across async boundaries.
